normalization.reference_contribution_ev: An authoring ratio in a fixed calibration scene, not lumens, watts, candela or measured irradiance. A change of one EV doubles the calibrated linear signal.

CAL-LIGHT-001.scene: Original reference scene: B=1000 mm; centered Lambertian sphere radius 0.25B with linear reflectance 0.18; no floor, environment emission or other lights.
CAL-LIGHT-001.measurement: Measure each emitter separately using six fixed orthographic views along +/-X, +/-Y and +/-Z. Average masked-sphere linear luminance in each view, then average the six means. Use the same sampling, camera geometry and scene version for all emitters.
CAL-LIGHT-001.target: Zero reference EV is one arbitrary normalized linear response unit. An emitter target is 2 raised to its reference EV. An adapter must solve and record the corresponding source gain; this dataset does not invent that gain.
CAL-LIGHT-001.camera: Reference camera exposure is fixed at 0 EV for calibration; use linear scene-referred values before view transforms. This is a calibration fixture requirement, not a command to change the user camera.
CAL-LIGHT-001.scale: Resolve gains at the applied physical scale before locking the rig. Do not treat point intensity and area radiance as interchangeable.
CAL-LIGHT-001.state: Calibration procedure specified; no calibration renders or measurements have been performed.

normalization.CAL-ENV-SUN-001: Use the same reference sphere and six-view measurement with only the resolved environment sun active. That recorded signal becomes zero reference EV for explicitly editorial fill; preserve the environment sun unchanged.
normalization.relative_solar_irradiance: A dimensionless illustrative solar reference. Value 1.0 is not a measured lunar or terrestrial irradiance.
normalization.orientation: For target_b lights, aim the emitting front normal toward target_b. Project world +Z into the light plane as local up; if degenerate, use +Y. Apply roll_rad about the emitting normal. Width follows local right and height local up.
normalization.capability_failure: Missing required capabilities or unresolved references block authoring with no scene mutation. No silent material, light-type, medium or optical-model substitution is permitted.
